bundle.confirmDownloads: I confirmed this site’s downloads finished; clear idle temporary files
bundle.downloadsCleared: Temporary files for the confirmed downloads have been cleared.
bundle.downloadRequested: Download requested. Check your browser downloads to confirm the file was saved.

clipboardPaste.retryHint: Retry uses the exact first transaction and identities. If retry cannot finish, close and reopen the workspace to check its saved state.

sequence.sourceFileHint: Local source backup only, not a published diagram or transaction recovery. Finish the guided review to export its source. Import replaces the unsent preview and needs validation and fresh consent; it never inserts automatically. Canvas text may be private.
sequence.sourceFileWorking: Reading or exporting local authoring source…
sequence.sourceFileSaved: Source file saved. The canvas and transaction history are unchanged.
sequence.sourceDownloadRequested: Source download requested; completion is controlled by the browser.
sequence.sourceFileLoaded: Authoring source loaded. Validate, review and approve before saving to the canvas.
sequence.sourceFileStopped: Source file operation stopped; no diagram was published.
sequence.sourceFileFailed: Source file operation is unconfirmed or invalid. No diagram was published; check any selected output before retrying export.
sequence.sourceTextLimit: Source exceeds 64 KiB UTF-8 or contains invalid Unicode. Original source was retained.
sequence.unavailable: This workspace does not support sequence diagrams.
sequence.publicationUnconfirmed: Saving the original transaction was not confirmed. Close and check draft recovery/sync before another edit; it may already be retained. No automatic retry or replacement transaction.
sequence.operationBudget: Expanded operations: {count} / {limit}. The complete transaction must fit; it is never split into partial updates. Reduce the changes if over the limit.
sequence.editHint: Guided editing preserves matching semantic identities. Message endpoint changes create replacement relations in one transaction. External objects or links are never cascaded. Editing source may regenerate semantic IDs.
sequence.editBlocked: The edit could not form a valid complete transaction. Check locks, external children/links on removed participants or blocks, canvas limits and supported semantics. Nothing was applied.
sequence.authoringHint: Write the supported Mermaid sequence syntax, validate, review the full preview, then confirm insertion. Preview and closing do not save the canvas.
sequence.guidedHint: Build ordered participants and messages without writing Mermaid. Changes stay in this draft until preview and explicit insertion.
sequence.guidedTo: Message target (same source creates a self-message)
sequence.guidedInsertionTarget: New message will be inserted before {target} in the selected branch.
sequence.guidedBlocks: In the selected branch: loop wraps the last step; alt / parallel wrap the last two steps as separate branches. Select nested branches to edit their contents without flattening them.
sequence.guidedBranchHint: Choose the root or one named branch. New messages, ordering, deletion and wrapping affect only this location; alternative / parallel branches remain distinct.
sequence.guidedInvalid: Invalid label, capacity or dependency. Referenced participants cannot be removed. The existing draft was retained.
sequence.guidedCancel: Discard guided edits and return to source
sequence.reviewSummary: {participants} participants, {messages} messages. Review branches and message direction before insertion.
sequence.confirm: I reviewed the diagram and confirm insertion
sequence.stale: The canvas or permissions changed. Close and reopen to review again.
sequence.invalidSize: The diagram exceeds the supported canvas bounds. Reduce the content and try again.
sequence.saveFailed: Saving failed. The exact first transaction is retained for retry.

penDraft.publicationUnconfirmed: The original path transaction is unconfirmed and may already be retained or committed. Close and check pending submission / draft recovery before editing or inserting again. Closing is not rollback.
penDraft.sourceChanged: The canvas or permissions changed before submission. Close and reopen to review the current source.
penDraft.alignmentHint: Show horizontal and vertical guides when a point aligns with another anchor or the drawing center.
penDraft.alignmentSnapHint: Snap nearby points to alignment guides. Turn off to position points freely.
penDraft.editHint: Apply updates this object and keeps its connections. Preview and cancel do not save the canvas.
penDraft.editUnavailable: This path is locked or cannot be reopened in the current single-contour editor. Compound paths and paths with more than 1,024 anchors are preserved without changes.
penDraft.invalidPath: This path has no visible geometry, exceeds the canvas size limit, or is too complex. Edit the path and try again.
penDraft.insertHint: Insert saves this path to the canvas as one undoable change. Closing without inserting discards this editor draft.
penDraft.insertFailed: The canvas changed or saving failed. The first insertion is retained for retry; close and reopen if the canvas changed.
penDraft.unavailable: This workspace does not support vector paths.
penDraft.invalidCoordinates: Coordinates must be finite and within bounds, including both handles after moving an anchor. Not applied.
penDraft.coordinateInstructions: Local coordinates: −1,000,000 to 1,000,000. Input is applied only on confirmation. A missing handle is created on apply; anchor moves translate both handles.
penDraft.title: Pen path draft
penDraft.warning: Unsaved editing draft. Closing or changing workspace discards it. Vector Node persistence and sync are not connected; nothing is inserted into the live canvas.
penDraft.instructions: Add mode: tap to add an anchor, drag to create curve handles. Edit mode: drag anchors; select one to drag its handles. Multitouch or cancellation does not commit the drag.
penDraft.invalid: Coordinates exceeded the editing limit. This drag was not committed.
penDraft.hintAdd: Add mode: click the canvas to place a point (anchor); drag to pull out a curve handle.
penDraft.hintEdit: Edit mode: drag a point to move it; select a point to drag its curve handles.
penDraft.hintRedo: Redo the change you just undid.
penDraft.hintOpen: Leave the path open: the last point is not joined to the first.
penDraft.hintClosePath: Close the path: join the last point back to the first so the shape can be filled.
penDraft.hintFill: Turn fill on or off for the area inside the path.
penDraft.hintFillColor: Choose the color that fills the inside of the shape.
penDraft.hintStrokeColor: Choose the color of the path outline.
penDraft.hintApplyWidth: Apply the outline width typed on the left.
penDraft.hintNonZero: Non-zero fill: any area enclosed by the path is filled, even where the path overlaps itself.
penDraft.hintEvenOdd: Even-odd fill: overlapping areas alternate between filled and empty, which makes holes.
penDraft.hintCorner: Make the selected point a sharp corner by removing its curve handles.
penDraft.hintCurve: Make the selected point smooth by giving it curve handles.
penDraft.hintAddCenterAnchor: Add a new point at the center of the drawing area.
penDraft.hintPreviousAnchor: Select the previous point on the path.
penDraft.hintNextAnchor: Select the next point on the path.
penDraft.hintFocusAnchor: Scroll the view so the selected point is in the center.
penDraft.hintPan: Pan mode: drag to move the view without changing the path.
penDraft.hintFit: Zoom and move the view so the whole path and its handles are visible.
penDraft.hintResetView: Reset the view to the default zoom and position.
penDraft.hintInsert: Save the path onto the canvas as one undoable change.
penDraft.hintApplyPath: Update the existing path object, keeping its connections.

draftMerge.checked: Access, version and media checks passed for this read. Nothing was applied or submitted. Confirmation, original acknowledgement and submission are not connected.
draftMerge.reviewAgain: Remote state changed. Explicitly load the latest comparison; all old choices will be cleared. Reselect and recheck. Nothing was applied or submitted.
draftMerge.blocked: Check stopped ({reason}). Nothing was applied or submitted. Resolve access, pending drafts or service contracts first.
draftMerge.title: Per-property merge plan
draftMerge.warning: Choose remote or draft for every changed field; nothing is selected automatically. Creation/deletion and type changes are whole-entity choices. This only validates a proposal, not authorization, media access or an original acknowledgement. New-operation creation and submission are not connected yet.
draftMerge.valid: Plan structure is valid. Nothing was applied or submitted. Fresh authority and explicit confirmation are still required.
draftMerge.invalid: Choices violate group, relation or lock constraints. Resolve dependent choices; nothing was applied or submitted.

draftImport.selectionCancelled: File selection cancelled. No backup was inspected or applied.
draftImport.fileWarning: Choose your JSON backup or paste its contents. The selected file is read locally, up to 4 MiB, without changing it or retaining its path. It contains private canvas content; your OS may sync clipboard contents. Press Validate and inspect for a fresh read-permission check and read-only comparison. No merge, media downloads or automatic submission.
draftImport.title: Inspect JSON backup
draftImport.warning: Paste your draft-review JSON backup explicitly. It contains private canvas content; your OS may sync clipboard contents. Validation and a fresh read-permission check precede read-only inspection. No file picker, merge, media downloads or automatic submission.
draftImport.failed: Backup is invalid, unsupported, too large, or read permission / workspace changed. Nothing was applied or submitted.
draftImport.previewWarning: Imported historical draft compared with a fresh remote snapshot. Saved remote content is not authority. Per-property planning is read-only; applying the merge and original submission reconciliation are not connected yet.

draftReview.originalReading: Waiting for the original flow or reading original records / receipt…
draftReview.originalTransactionsHint: Inspect the original saved transaction or draft. These actions do not resend, fence, delete records or create a replacement request. A receipt query is read-only, not a full acknowledgement.
draftReview.previewHint: Compare versions at the same position and scale. Preview does not save. Media shows metadata placeholders without downloading or playing.
draftReview.previewUnavailable: This version cannot be fully rendered. Review the property differences below.
draftReview.previewEmpty: This version has no canvas objects.
draftReview.downloadRequested: Download requested. Check browser downloads to confirm the file was saved; it may be blocked or cancelled. Import is not supported yet.
draftReview.downloadFailed: Download could not be requested or the draft changed. The draft is retained. Check browser downloads before retrying; an already-started download cannot be recalled.
draftReview.downloadWarning: Contains private canvas content. After permission is checked, a JSON download is requested with a generated filename. Your browser controls the location, filename, overwrite prompts and completion; synced folders may upload it. No automatic import or server upload.
draftReview.saveFolderWarning: Contains private canvas content. Choose a trusted folder in Files; synced providers may upload it. A new boarderless-draft-…json file is created there with a generated name. No overwrite, bookmark or automatic import.
draftReview.saved: JSON backup saved. Import is not supported yet.
draftReview.saveCancelled: File selection cancelled; no backup was written.
draftReview.saveFailed: Backup could not be saved. Use a new filename; existing files are not overwritten. Check the selected location if a write was interrupted; incomplete files are removed when possible.
draftReview.saveWarning: Contains private canvas content. Choose a trusted local folder; synced folders may upload it. Use a new filename: existing files will not be overwritten. This backup cannot be imported yet.
draftReview.title: Read-only local draft review
draftReview.baselineMatches: The remote workspace still matches the draft baseline. Review does not submit changes.
draftReview.baselineChanged: The remote workspace no longer matches the baseline. Resolve conflicts explicitly; do not overwrite it with this draft.
draftReview.submissionWarning: This draft includes an unconfirmed submission or is quarantined. Matching content is not an acknowledgement; review the original submission result. Stopping resend does not undo a commit.
draftReview.copyWarning: The backup includes private canvas text and historical baseline. Your OS may sync clipboard contents to other devices. Copy only after confirmation; this is not a REST request and automatic import is unsupported.
draftReview.copied: JSON backup copied. Paste it into a local file to save. Neither the journal nor the server was changed.
draftReview.unavailable: Read permission could not be confirmed or the draft changed. The draft is retained; no backup was copied.
draftReview.readOnly: Object/relation property comparison, not an editable canvas. No old media downloads, remote adoption or acknowledgement. Original operation IDs in order:
draftReview.noDifferences: The final draft matches its baseline. Its operations remain saved; nothing is automatically removed or submitted.
draftReview.remoteMatchesDraft: Remote matches the draft (not an acknowledgement)

presence.realtimeIdle: Realtime collaboration has not been started.
presence.realtimeDiagnostic: Last safe diagnostic — stage: {stage}; code: {code}; HTTP: {http}; declared retry wait (ms): {retry}. No credentials or frame content included.
presence.realtimePreparing: Preparing the durable checkpoint and connection…
presence.realtimeCatchingUp: Catching up and saving complete transactions…
presence.realtimeLive: Realtime connection is live. Cursor and selection are shared only when you enable sharing.
presence.realtimeSocketWrites: Writes use WebSocket with the original durable request. Lost ACKs require original receipt verification; no automatic REST fallback.
presence.realtimeRestWrites: Writes currently use REST. WebSocket writes require durable pending storage and a client sequence allocator on this platform.
presence.writeMissingPrerequisites: WebSocket write prerequisites missing: {items}. This is platform configuration, not a server acknowledgement. Reconnecting cannot initialize or migrate storage.
presence.realtimeDisconnected: Realtime disconnected. REST refresh remains available.
presence.realtimeResync: A full resync is required. Disconnect and reconnect explicitly.
presence.realtimeRevoked: Workspace access was revoked. Realtime sharing has stopped.
presence.realtimeFailedHint: Realtime connection could not be confirmed. No automatic reconnect or write retry. Disconnect before trying again.
presence.restOnly: This backend uses REST polling, not realtime collaboration. Live cursors and Presence require the realtime service.
presence.socketCapability: WebSocket-capable transport; live connection status is shown separately above.
presence.noLiveTransport: No realtime transport is configured. Local saves and member access do not establish a live room.
presence.sharingHint: Sharing starts only when you choose it. Viewport and text are not shared. Reconnect resets sharing.
presence.sharingUnavailable: Cursor sharing requires an authenticated live transport. Not available on this connection.

giphy.unsupportedWorkspace: This workspace cannot save GIPHY references yet.
giphy.exportPending: This version cannot export GIPHY references as PNG or PDF yet. Select other objects to export.
giphy.queryHint: Search on demand; no requests while typing. Beta keys allow 100 API calls/hour. Results remain in GIPHY order.
giphy.keyHint: Enter this platform's GIPHY key for this session only. It is not saved or sent to our backend.
giphy.keyHintSaved: Enter this platform's GIPHY key. It is saved in this device's protected key vault and is not sent to our backend.
giphy.loadingQuery: Loading a new query; existing results are kept until it succeeds.
giphy.loadingPage: Loading the next page (offset {offset}); existing results are kept.
giphy.queryCancelled: Query cancelled. Previous results and their next-page position are retained; no automatic retry.
giphy.rateLimit: GIPHY request limit reached. Automatic requests are stopped; retry after the cooldown.
giphy.retryIn: GIPHY limit reached. Wait about {seconds} seconds, then retry explicitly; the current page offset is retained.
giphy.retryReady: The local cooldown ended. You can retry explicitly; GIPHY may still apply a shared-key limit.
giphy.queryChanged: The text differs from the displayed search. Search explicitly, or restore the original text to continue its pages.
giphy.invalidKey: Check this platform's GIPHY API key.
giphy.unavailable: GIPHY is unavailable. Your canvas is unaffected.
giphy.previewUnavailable: Preview unavailable on this platform. You can view it on GIPHY.
giphy.externalReferencePending: Canvas insertion awaits external-reference support. GIPHY media is not uploaded to workspace storage. Official attribution is displayed; production integration approval remains pending.

media.v2AdvancedHint: For an interrupted original upload, review its current status before these explicit steps. Replacing a ticket supersedes its old lease; collapsing this section does not clear or cancel any record.
media.v2WatchHint: Approve up to 20 server status reads, about 3 seconds apart, stopping after 60 seconds at most. Verified identity or lease changes are saved in the original local record. This does not reupload, complete again or insert a node. Cancel anytime; choose insertion separately when ready.
media.v2WatchEnded: Observation ended without a new ready result. The original preparation is retained; you can check again later. No upload or completion was retried.
media.v2ReadFailed: The local action or status read did not finish. Original upload records are retained; check the original status before any write. No upload was automatically retried.
media.v2CleanupPending: A device-local file handle could not be released. It is not reused. Retry local cleanup before choosing or uploading another file; saved requests and server assets are unchanged.
media.v2CleanupDone: Device-local handles released. No saved request or server asset was deleted.
media.v2Archive: Check terminal state and archive this local record
media.v2Unarchive: Restore this record to the active list
media.v2Archived: Archived locally. The original request, lease history and server asset were not deleted. This does not release index capacity.
media.v2Unarchived: Shown in the active list again. No asset was revived or uploaded.
media.v2ArchiveUnconfirmed: Local archive visibility was not confirmed. Reload both lists before changing it again; the original identity was not deleted and no asset was revived.
media.v2AttemptHint: A saved write intent is not proof of success or dispatch. Check the original server request before continuing; no automatic retry.
media.v2RetryOriginalPrepare: Authorize re-sending the same prepare request (same ID, no replacement)
media.v2AccessFailure: Access was rejected. Check authentication and membership; no write is retried automatically.
media.v2LookupUnknown: Not found is not proof that the original prepare cannot commit. Keep this request ID and check again explicitly.
media.v2LeaseFailure: This ticket is expired or superseded. Keep the original asset identity; explicitly authorize a replacement ticket if needed.
media.v2UnknownOutcome: The outcome may be unknown. Keep the original request and check its server state before another write.
media.v2SourceFailure: This file is invalid or differs from the reserved original. Reselect the original file; its reservation has not been replaced.
media.v2PreparedHint: Reserved, not ready. Upload with a confirmed ticket, then complete. After interruption, check the original request first.
media.v2ProcessingHint: Completion accepted; verification is pending. Use Check to refresh explicitly. Do not upload again or insert yet.
media.v2ReadyHint: Verified ready. Insert explicitly; this will use the normal canvas transaction.
media.v2TerminalHint: This original preparation is terminal. It is retained for review, not revived or automatically replaced.
media.v2Unavailable: Durable v2 upload storage is unavailable for this server session. No v1 fallback or upload was started.
media.v2New: Start a new reservation (keep previous records)
media.v2Hint: Each write requires an explicit action. Closing keeps the original reservation. No automatic retry or insertion.
media.v2Recovered: Original reservation loaded. Check its server state before continuing; reselect the original file for upload.
media.v2UploadFlow: Authorize and upload this new original
media.v2UploadFlowHint: For a never-attempted original only: authorize prepare → upload ticket → file upload → completion. It stops on failure or cancellation, without replay or polling. Check processing status explicitly, then approve canvas insertion once ready.
media.v2StepDone: Step completed. Continue explicitly or check the server state.
media.v2Stopped: Stopped. The original reservation is retained; no write is automatically retried.
media.libraryHint: Reuse stored media without uploading it again. Only ready, supported assets can be inserted.
media.searchAssets: Search by title, asset ID or type…
media.selectionAssetsUnavailable: The selection's media is not verified in this canvas. Refresh assets before cutting or pasting. Media transfer between canvases is not available yet.
media.recoveryHint: Uploads to review on this device. Checking refreshes metadata only. Dismiss removes the reminder, not the stored asset.
media.recoveryUnavailable: Local upload reminders could not be read or saved. No upload is retried automatically.
media.assetsUnavailable: Asset metadata is unavailable. Check the connection and refresh.
media.unsupportedAsset: Supported formats: PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, MP4 and WebM. HEIC or MOV/QuickTime require conversion to a supported representation; changing the filename extension is not conversion.
media.assetTooLarge: This asset exceeds the 200 MiB client limit.
media.assetInsertFailed: Stored media could not be inserted. Refresh its status and try again.
media.assetInsertUnconfirmed: Media insertion is unconfirmed; the original transaction may already be retained or committed. Check the pending submission / draft review before inserting again to avoid duplicates. The stored asset is not deleted.
media.selecting: Choose an image, GIF or video…
media.importRecoveryRequired: Import stopped. Check asset {id} in Object library → Workspace media before uploading again.
media.importFailed: Media import failed. Check the file and connection, then try again.
media.importInvalidFile: The selected file could not be validated. Check its format and try selecting it again.
media.importSelectionFailed: The selected document could not be read. Check file availability and access permission.
media.importPreparationFailed: Upload preparation failed. Check API connectivity and workspace access.
media.importUploadFailed: File transfer failed. Check the storage connection and public endpoint configuration.
media.importConfirmationFailed: Upload confirmation stopped. Check stored media status before uploading again.
media.importProcessingFailed: Media processing stopped. Check stored media status before uploading again.
media.transferUnavailable: Media upload is not available on this server yet.
media.importNotInserted: Media stored, but no object was added. Reuse it from Object library → Workspace media.
media.rejectionUploadMissing: The uploaded file was not found. Check its status before uploading again.
media.rejectionByteSizeMismatch: The uploaded size does not match the prepared file.
media.rejectionMediaTypeMismatch: The actual file format does not match its declared type.
media.rejectionUnsupportedFormat: The server does not support this file format.
media.rejectionUndecodableMedia: The server could not decode this file. Check the source file and codec.
media.rejectionDimensionsExceeded: The media dimensions exceed the server's limit.
media.rejectionInvalidDuration: A valid video duration could not be determined.
media.rejectionDurationExceeded: The media duration exceeds the server's limit.
media.rejectionDeclaredMetadataMismatch: The measured display dimensions or duration do not match the declared metadata. The original upload identity has been retained; do not upload again automatically.
media.rejectionUnknown: Server validation failed. Record the asset ID for investigation.
media.audioFocusBlocked: Audio interrupted • Tap to retry playback

status.pendingRecoveryRequired: An unconfirmed change is saved on this device. Review it before editing.
status.pendingDraftRequired: This device has {operationCount} saved draft changes. Confirm restore and submit, or remove the local draft.
status.pendingDraftDismissWarning: Only the saved draft on this device is removed. Server content is not undone, changed or deleted. This draft cannot be restored.
status.pendingDraftDismissed: Local draft removed; authoritative workspace loaded.
status.pendingDraftReviewRequired: The draft baseline or original submission needs review. The draft is retained and will not be automatically resent.
status.pendingDraftSaveFailed: Local draft could not be saved. This change was not applied or submitted.
status.atomicOperationLimit: This atomic change expands to {count} operations (limit {limit}). No draft, history or request was published. Reduce the change; it will not be split into partial updates.
status.awaitedDraftSaveUnconfirmed: Local storage could not be confirmed. No new canvas state was shown; reload the document to confirm before retrying.
status.awaitedDraftScopeChanged: The document scope changed while saving. The retained draft was not published into the current canvas.
status.pendingRecoveryUnavailable: Recovery could not be confirmed. The saved request has been retained.
status.pendingRecoveryReviewed: Recovery reviewed; the authoritative canvas has been loaded.
status.stoppedArchiveNotice: Only local resend was stopped; the server may have committed these transactions. Lookup never clears archives or drafts, resends, fences, or merges. A commit summary is not a full acknowledgement.
status.stoppedArchiveUnavailable: Original submission archives could not be read. Evidence is retained; storage or a legacy archive catalog needs recovery.
status.stoppedArchiveCommitted: The server confirms this original transaction committed; this summary is not a full ACK. Run the separate full verification. Archive and draft remain unchanged.
status.stoppedArchiveVerify: Verify full records and latest canvas
status.stoppedArchiveSavedRecord: Saved evidence exists, not current authorization; reverify before any later Apply.
status.stoppedArchiveEvidenceSaved: Fresh complete evidence was saved atomically with the original wire/draft. Quarantine remains; no merge or replacement transaction. Later Apply still requires fresh access and version checks.
status.stoppedArchiveSaveUncertain: Evidence save could not be confirmed and may have completed. Original wire and draft are retained; reread, do not automatically retry or Apply.
status.stoppedArchiveAtomicUnavailable: Atomic storage is not activated for this adapter. Read-only verification is available, but it cannot authorize or Apply a merge.
status.stoppedArchiveVerifiedCommitted: Full original records, submitted values and fresh access/canvas were verified. This is read-only: no ACK saved, quarantine cleared or merge applied. Archive and draft remain unchanged.
status.stoppedArchiveVerifiedFenced: The server confirms the original transaction is fenced; fresh access/canvas were read. Quarantine and draft are unchanged, no merge applied or replacement transaction authorized.
status.pendingFenceWarning: Permanently block this uncommitted original transaction on the server; this cannot be undone. If commit wins first, its receipt is returned instead. The draft remains; no merge or replacement is automatic. Cancel only applies before dispatch.
status.pendingFenceUncertain: The fence result is unconfirmed and may already have applied. Recheck the original result; do not resend or create a replacement. The draft remains.
status.pendingReceiptConfirm: Verify full records and settle recovery
status.pendingReceiptCommitted: The server confirms the original transaction committed. This is not a full ACK; continue recovery verification. The draft is retained.
status.pendingReceiptFenced: The server fenced the original transaction. Do not resend it. The draft is retained for separate merge review.
status.pendingReceiptUnknown: No commit evidence at the lookup head. The original request can still arrive later; this does not authorize a replacement transaction.
status.pendingReceiptFailed: The original result could not be verified or lookup is unavailable. The request is retained; no automatic resend or fence occurred.
status.pendingRecoveryDismissWarning: This only stops local resend and archives the original request. The server may already have accepted it; this does not undo or delete server content.

qa.developmentOnly: Development-only QA tools • Not stored in the workspace
qa.questionMediaLibrary: Can stored ready media be searched, previewed and inserted again without re-uploading, while read-only roles remain read-only?
qa.evidenceMediaLibrary: SOP 5.23: record workspace/user/role, asset ID, MIME/status, query/page and before/after insertion screenshots. Verify fresh metadata, poster-only video cards and rejected operation rollback. Builds and mock tests do not prove real storage or touch acceptance.
qa.questionMediaCompletionRecovery: Does cancellation or a lost completion response preserve potentially accepted media without deleting it or falsely creating a Node?
qa.evidenceMediaCompletionRecovery: SOP 5.24: attach asset ID, request timeline, cancellation point, server status and recovery screenshots. Include durable commit followed by a lost reply, processing timeout and abandon/complete races; a mock 503 is not proof of server acceptance. Keep pending without the real backend fixture.
qa.questionMediaDownloadCancellation: Do cancelled downloads stop publishing chunks or Ready, and do metadata reads reject the wrong asset/workspace?
qa.evidenceMediaDownloadCancellation: SOP 5.25: record authorize/chunk/write/verification/commit cancellation, late native callbacks and cache cleanup. Distinguish an uncommitted temporary file from an already verified cache entry. Attach logs without signed URLs or credentials; verify thumbnail source identity and status.
qa.questionMediaRestartRecovery: Can upload reminders survive an app restart, remain account/workspace-scoped and query the asset directly without automatic retry or deletion?
qa.evidenceMediaRestartRecovery: SOP 5.26: attach restart-before/after, account/workspace switching, direct GET and dismissal evidence. Include 404/403, stale-list response ordering, full/corrupt local storage and read-only roles. Dismiss removes only a local reminder. A new store instance is not an actual process-restart test.
qa.questionMediaAssets: Do real asset upload, completion, thumbnails, authorized download and reopen work?
qa.evidenceMediaAssets: Record server/storage versions, workspace, format, size/checksum, reopen and cancellation. Keep pending while the backend is off or BAI-003 is missing; a mock gateway is not storage acceptance.
qa.questionMediaGif: Are GIF frames, delays, loops, pause, Reduce Motion and cleanup correct?
qa.questionGiphyBrowser: Do GIPHY key editing, explicit search, paging, limits, thumbnails, refresh and GIF preview work without canvas shortcut conflicts?
qa.evidenceGiphyBrowser: SOP 5.30: record platform, exact query, provider order, no typing requests, 429 without retry, URL preservation, cancellation, 3-load bound, pause and background return. Test paste/select-all/delete using a fake key; never put real keys or credential URLs in notes, screenshots or exports. Mock tests do not prove real API/CDN/CORS behavior.
qa.questionGiphyCanvas: Can a GIPHY reference be inserted, reopened, shared, edited, undone and copied without rehosting its media or persisting keys/URLs?
qa.evidenceGiphyCanvas: Keep Pending until BAI-010 external-media support and real round-trip tests exist. Record object/provider IDs, roles, relations, transforms, clipboard/Quick Scheme and two-client sync; missing content must remain a recoverable placeholder. A working browser or GIF preview is not Canvas acceptance. Use N/A only with an explicit scope exclusion.
qa.questionGiphyProduct: Has the product owner approved the GIPHY grid, official attribution, keyboard/VoiceOver, touch targets and mobile panel occlusion?
qa.evidenceGiphyProduct: SOP 5.30: attach dark/light, DPI, orientation, grid/outer-panel scroll and playing/paused screenshots; show the original fixed attribution without crop/tint, input focus and no Dynamic Island/keyboard occlusion. Record reviewer, date and decision. Builds/hash checks cannot sign off visuals or GIPHY production approval; performance remains deferred.
qa.evidenceMediaGif: Record platform, fixture, finite/infinite loops and foreground return; attach actual visuals and distinguish native decoder tests from device acceptance.
qa.questionMediaVideo: Do video play, pause, seek, replay, mute and actual audio work?
qa.evidenceMediaVideo: Record container/codec/audio tracks, OS/device, speakers/headphones/Bluetooth and AV sync. Fake PCM or silent fixtures cannot sign off audio.
qa.questionMediaDisplay: Are video rotation, mirroring and non-square sample proportions correct?
qa.evidenceMediaDisplay: On Desktop record rotation/SAR, encoded/display dimensions, first frame/seek/replay and orientation/proportion screenshots. Record other platforms within scope; do not pass unfinished HDR support.
qa.questionMediaLifecycle: Do offscreen, background, minimize, workspace/account changes and deletion stop and clean up media?
qa.evidenceMediaLifecycle: Test download, prepare, playing and paused states; verify no automatic resume and file/player cleanup. Record quick hide/show and focus changes separately.
qa.questionMediaErrors: Do playback, seek, audio and close failures stop, release and allow an explicit retry?
qa.evidenceMediaErrors: Attach reproduction steps, original/cleanup errors, continued app usability and renewed authorization. Verify the old player ends even without a native failure state.
qa.questionMediaPackage: Do packaged runtime checks, installation and native dependencies pass?
qa.evidenceMediaPackage: Attach OS/architecture, version, --check-media-runtime exit code and output; record installation, signing/notarization and license review separately. macOS does not sign off Windows/Linux.
qa.questionMediaVisual: Has the product owner signed off media quality, proportions, layers, touch and menu occlusion?
qa.evidenceMediaVisual: Attach device/orientation, selection/drag/rotation/resize, Node/Group/Layer, Dynamic Island/keyboard/bottom-sheet screenshots, reviewer and conclusion.
qa.questionFunctional: Can the primary workflow be completed without an error or false success state?
qa.questionPersistence: Do save, reopen, retry and interruption preserve the authoritative result?
qa.questionDraftRecovery: Does reopening preserve dependent draft changes, resolve the original transaction before user-confirmed tail submission, and avoid duplicate commits or overwriting remote changes?
qa.evidenceDraftRecovery: Follow SOP §6: record wire/draft IDs, count/order, interrupted acknowledgement/cleanup, baseline/version/serverSeq, viewer, stop-resend and second confirmation. Keep pending without real restart/service acceptance; never record credentials or private canvas text.
qa.questionPermissions: Do owner, editor, commenter and viewer permissions behave as specified?
qa.questionMobileInteraction: Can touch, text editing, multi-select and bottom-sheet interactions complete without stealing control?
qa.questionVisual: Is the visual hierarchy clear, modern and appropriate for the product?
qa.questionOcclusion: Are Dynamic Island, system bars, keyboard, modal, bottom sheet and floating controls free of unacceptable occlusion?
qa.questionOperationOwnership: Does the interface leave canvas selection, dragging and editing under the user's control?
qa.questionVoiceOver: Are names, roles, states, focus order and alternative actions usable with VoiceOver?
qa.questionRegression: Do workspace, history, clipboard, schemes, search and collaboration regressions pass?
qa.questionPerformanceDeferred: Is performance testing correctly deferred until feature and integration stabilization?
qa.noScreenshots: No screenshots attached. Captured images are embedded in exported documents.
qa.noDocuments: No documents generated in this session

aiProbe.profileHint: Reads the same non-secret Desktop settings used by diagram tools. Your current key and approval are cleared; no saved key is read, settings are not changed, and no request is sent. Review the endpoint and parameters before entering a key and approving this request.
aiProbe.profileMissing: No readable saved Desktop settings were returned. They may be absent, invalid or inaccessible. Original fields are retained; enter settings here or check the diagram tools settings.
aiProbe.profileLoaded: Connection settings loaded. No key was loaded and no request was sent. Review the settings and enter credentials if required.
aiProbe.profileCancelled: Settings read cancelled. Your current key and approval remain cleared; no request was sent.
aiProbe.profileFailed: Cannot read supported connection settings. Existing fields are retained, but the current key and approval are cleared. No request was sent.
aiProbe.consentDeclined: Not authorized. This request was not sent; the task has stopped.
aiProbe.debugHintReasoningTools: Provider confirmed: this model rejects reasoning with function tools in Chat Completions. Use the updated GPT-5.6 tool request (reasoning_effort=none). Changing only the endpoint to Responses will not work; its wire format differs.
aiProbe.debugHintConfig: AI not dispatched: check complete endpoint, dialect, model, credential format and HTTP policy.
aiProbe.debugHintWorkspace: AI not dispatched: workspace scope, version or local snapshot differs from the backend. Wait for sync, then close and reopen this window.
aiProbe.debugHintBackend: AI not dispatched: workspace backend access/version check failed or timed out. Any HTTP status here belongs to the workspace backend, not AI.
aiProbe.debugAuthenticationRejected: Authentication rejected; no model output received
aiProbe.debugAccessDenied: Access denied; no model output received
aiProbe.debugHintMissingCredentials: HTTP 401: no authentication header was prepared. Go back and check the key and authentication mode; do not select None if the Router requires authentication. No automatic retry.
aiProbe.debugHintBasicChallenge: HTTP 401: the response advertises Basic authentication, possibly from a proxy or Router. The app supports Bearer, x-api-key or None only. Check the service entry point and proxy settings; do not put a username/password into API Key. No automatic retry.
aiProbe.debugHintForbidden: HTTP 403: access was denied. Check Router/upstream model, project and account permissions. This status does not prove whether the key is valid. No automatic retry.
aiProbe.debugHintAuth: HTTP 401: authentication was rejected before model output. Check the service URL, its key and authentication mode; also check upstream authentication on a Local AI Router. This record cannot identify the rejecting layer and does not indicate a temperature error. No automatic retry; never share your key.
aiProbe.debugHintEndpoint: AI HTTP 404: check the complete API path and model availability.
aiProbe.debugHintRequest: AI HTTP request parameters rejected. Check dialect/model compatibility with stream and max_completion_tokens/max_tokens. Max tokens and temperature are sent only when their fields are filled.
aiProbe.debugHintLimit: AI HTTP 429 may indicate rate or quota limits. Check the provider account; no automatic retry.
aiProbe.debugHintServer: AI returned 5xx. Check Router/provider status or retry manually later.
aiProbe.debugHintNetwork: AI connection failed or timed out. Check network, TLS/proxy and service availability. Without an HTTP response, server receipt is unconfirmed.
aiProbe.debugHintFormat: Response is not supported text SSE, or stream/tool mode is incompatible. HTTP 200 does not mean the test completed.
aiProbe.debugHintIncomplete: AI output did not finish normally or exceeded limits. Reduce scope and check the output budget; this is not success.
aiProbe.debugHintEmpty: The AI stream finished, but returned no nonblank text or supported tool calls. No proposal is accepted and no retry is automatic.
aiProbe.replySummary: Reply: {textBytes} text bytes · {toolCalls} tool calls · {argumentBytes} argument bytes. A completed round does not mean canvas changes were applied.
aiProbe.localLog: Desktop safe diagnostics are collected locally in ~/.boarderless/logs/ai-probe.log (best effort, rotated). Includes redacted request parameters and error classifications; excludes keys, endpoints and canvas/raw response content.
aiProbe.previousAttempt: Previous attempt — settings or scope changed; these results do not describe the new configuration.
aiProbe.debugPreparing: Preparing request / validating configuration (AI not called)
aiProbe.debugWorkspace: Checking workspace access and version (AI not called)
aiProbe.debugConnecting: Starting HTTP request; waiting for response (server receipt unconfirmed)
aiProbe.debugHttp: HTTP response received; validating stream format
aiProbe.debugFailed: Request failed; inspect safe error code / HTTP status below
aiProbe.tokenLimitFieldHint: Use max_completion_tokens for current OpenAI models. Choose max_tokens only when your Router/model requires the older format. Blank token limits omit both fields; requests are not retried automatically.
aiProbe.maxTokens: Maximum output tokens (optional; blank omits parameter)
aiProbe.invalidParameters: Enter a positive integer for tokens and a finite number for temperature, or leave blank.
aiProbe.title: AI diagram understanding test
aiProbe.warning: Read-only diagram packet with explicit sequence metadata when in scope. Partial sequences omit unapproved details. Nothing changes on the canvas. N/E aliases are not step order. Text may be private; credentials are session-only.
aiProbe.consent: I approve sending this reviewed diagram packet to this endpoint (may incur cost)
aiProbe.response: AI response (or paste external test response)
aiProbe.inputRejected: Input was not accepted: invalid Unicode or more than 128 KiB of UTF-8. The previous answer is unchanged.
aiProbe.passed: Structural checks passed. This does not prove semantic understanding; review the summary yourself.
aiProbe.invalid: Invalid or oversized JSON. Review the raw answer; incomplete responses cannot pass.
aiProbe.failed: Request failed or configuration is invalid. Check endpoint, protocol, model and authorization. No automatic retry.
aiProbe.contextInvalid: No objects selected, or context exceeds 128 nodes / 256 links / 48 KiB. Select a smaller region.
aiProbe.copied: Copied. Clipboard may contain private node text.
aiProbe.complete: Response complete. Run structural checks and review its meaning.

aiTools.chatReasoningNone: GPT-5.6 Chat tool compatibility: reasoning_effort = none. This setting appears in every request for approval.
aiTools.title: Edit diagram with AI (draft)

aiTools.scope: Approved objects: {count}. Tools cannot read outside this scope.
aiTools.dataShared: Describe adding a branch, arranging nodes or inserting a node on a relation. Tools read approved text, positions, sizes and relations; image pixels and asset URLs are not sent. N/E aliases below are local to this task. Follow the arrows when describing relations.
aiTools.insertRelationNode: Insert a node on a relation and split it in two
aiTools.changeReviewHint: Inspect exact IDs and before/after properties. This is structural data, not rendered media content. Displayed revision is normalized to 1; Apply still uses the original complete proposal.
aiTools.changeTruncated: Display truncated at 4096 characters; the full proposal is retained. This excerpt is not an editable or importable draft.
aiTools.conflict: The selection has dependencies or a version conflict. Change exclusions or regenerate.
aiTools.applyConsent: I reviewed the selected changes and want to queue them for saving
aiTools.queued: Queued for saving; server confirmation is pending.
aiTools.appliedReviewInfo: The proposal was added to the canvas and queued, not confirmed by the server. Close this window to inspect the canvas; reopen AI for a fresh context.
aiTools.applyFailed: Could not queue the proposal. Check access, sync, versions and local draft storage.
aiTools.selectionFixed: The selection is fixed after the first save attempt. Verify the original pending submission / saved draft before starting again; direct re-apply is disabled.
aiTools.publicationUnconfirmed: The original proposal transaction is unconfirmed and may already be retained or committed. Close and verify pending submission / draft recovery before applying again. Closing does not roll it back.
aiTools.contextInvalid: Scope exceeds the tool limit or cannot be safely reviewed.
aiTools.waiting: Awaiting approval; nothing from this round has been sent.
aiTools.noChanges: The model returned no changes to apply.
aiTools.settingsSaveFailed: Could not save settings or the token. Nothing was changed.
aiTools.tokenProtected: The token is stored in the system key vault (macOS Keychain, Windows DPAPI or Linux libsecret). It is never written to the settings file.
aiTools.tokenUnprotected: This platform has no secure storage available, so the token only lives in memory until this window closes. It is never saved.
aiTools.tokenStored: A saved token is available. Type a new value to replace it.
aiTools.notConfigured: AI is not set up yet. Open AI settings first.
aiTools.composerHint: Describe the change you want to the diagram…
aiTools.inputRejected: Task input was not accepted: invalid Unicode or more than 64 KiB of UTF-8. The previous task is unchanged.
aiTools.finishDraftFirst: Apply or discard the current draft before sending another request.
aiTools.requestApproved: Request {round}: approved (see actual request status below)
aiTools.showBody: Show full content to be sent
aiTools.autoApprove: Auto-approve the next rounds of this chat
aiTools.autoApproveHint: Applies only to the same endpoint, model and scope. The first round always needs your approval, and every later request is still listed here with its full content.
aiTools.traceHint: Writes ~/.boarderless/logs/ai-trace.jsonl (local only, owner-only permissions, size-limited). It includes your task text, the arguments the AI sent and the tool results, which contain canvas text and positions. It never includes your token or endpoint. Off by default.

relationInsert.unconfirmed: Insertion is unconfirmed. Review the original transaction before another edit; do not apply again. Closing this window does not undo or cancel a committed transaction.
relationInsert.title: Insert node in connection
relationInsert.explanation: Replace the connection with two connections and a new node in one transaction. Label and intent stay on the first segment; the second segment has neither. Nothing is saved until confirmed.
relationInsert.backward: The actual arrow order is reversed: target → new node → source.
relationInsert.both: Both segments keep bidirectional arrows; this does not define a single execution order.
relationInsert.undirected: Both segments remain undirected; this splits a relationship, not an execution sequence.
relationInsert.consent: I reviewed the two segments and want to queue this change
relationInsert.failed: Cannot queue the insertion. The canvas, access or local draft storage changed; close and review again.
relationInsert.invalid: Use finite coordinates within ±1,000,000 and dimensions from 1 to 100,000; check text limits.
relationInsert.contextPreview: Preview includes the endpoints, new node and nearby objects. Adjust position and dimensions as needed.

workspaceStorage.writerRecoveryHint: The original retired repository is retained until its accounted storage operations finish and release is confirmed. Canvas editing and mode changes are paused. Closing this window does not release the owner, delete data, resend transactions or create a replacement writer.
workspaceStorage.writerDrainUnavailable: This repository cannot prove its storage drain here. The original handle is retained; do not assume storage is released or reset it.
workspaceStorage.writerDraining: Waiting for the original accounted storage operations…
workspaceStorage.writerStillHeld: Original release is not confirmed. No replacement writer was created by this recovery action.
workspaceStorage.title: Choose canvas storage
workspaceStorage.explanation: Local canvases and imported originals work offline and can be exchanged using scheme bundles. Server mode connects to the configured service. The modes save separately; data is not moved automatically. Change mode from Spaces.
workspaceStorage.preferenceFailed: Could not open storage or save the choice. Existing data is retained. Check storage access and other running instances.

cloudSchemes.localImportUnconfirmed: Local import is unconfirmed. Close this window and find pending local imports using this original request ID. Do not select another copy or start a new import; closing does not undo a save.
cloudSchemes.title: Cloud quick schemes
cloudSchemes.warning: Uses the selected server and account. No automatic sync. Review → save task → confirm send. Delete is permanent. Asset availability is not permission; importing saves a local scheme, never inserts canvas objects. Uncertain requests require explicit recovery within the original retention window.
cloudSchemes.cancelled: Stopped. A sending task may already have committed; its identity is retained.
cloudSchemes.failed: Not confirmed. Reload saved tasks; do not create a replacement request.
cloudSchemes.httpFailed: Cloud request HTTP {status}. A conflict, expired cursor or permission failure will not be retried automatically.
cloudSchemes.committedReload: The original request was confirmed and saved. Reload the cloud list before reviewing another change; this receipt may describe an earlier revision.
cloudSchemes.rejectedReload: The original request was rejected (HTTP {status}) and saved. Reload resources or review the conflict; do not reuse its old version.
cloudSchemes.tasksReloadFailed: The action finished, but saved tasks could not be reloaded. Its recorded result is not rolled back; read tasks again before sending anything.
cloudSchemes.reviewReplace: Review replacing cloud content with local scheme: {name}
cloudSchemes.fullReview: Full fixed mutation, in pages. Review content, asset bindings, target and ETag before staging. Replacement overwrites the selected cloud version; no automatic merge.
cloudSchemes.replaceCurrent: Review replacing the latest version with rejected content (not a merge)
cloudSchemes.reviewHint: Review the selected resource and change, then save the fixed task. Saving does not send it.
cloudSchemes.mediaMetadataOnly: Structural preview and server-reported media availability only. Originals are not downloaded or copied; availability is not an insertion permission.
cloudSchemes.multipleSourcesUnsupported: Cannot save this scheme in the current local format: its payload is unsupported or its media spans multiple source workspaces. Materialization is required; no sources will be merged silently.
cloudSchemes.imported: Saved locally. Nothing inserted on the canvas; media still requires source permission.
cloudSchemes.staged: Task saved. Send requires a separate confirmation.
cloudSchemes.tasksMustReload: Read the saved local tasks before continuing. The displayed task snapshot is not yet confirmed; no request will be sent automatically.
cloudSchemes.recover: Confirm resending the unchanged original request
cloudSchemes.recoveryHint: Recovery retains the original ID, key, body and ETag. Fresh server time and the original retention deadline are checked before sending. Missing clock evidence or an expired window stops recovery; failed replay does not prove the original failed. Legacy tasks without a deadline cannot be resent.
cloudSchemes.resultSaved: Result saved. Reload the cloud list to see current resources.
cloudSchemes.readConflict: Read remote state for this task
cloudSchemes.readbackHint: Readback is not a receipt. Matching content does not prove the original request succeeded. Full JSON is available in bounded pages. Sending/Unknown tasks remain unresolved.
cloudSchemes.remoteUnavailable: Remote resource is absent or unavailable. This does not prove deletion or cancel an in-flight request.
cloudSchemes.reapplyName: Review original name on latest content
cloudSchemes.saveAsNew: Review saving the rejected content as a new scheme

localSync.reviewMerge: Choose and review a merge plan
localSync.mergeTitle: Review the merge between both copies
localSync.mergeHint: Choose local or server content for each conflict. Uncontested changes are preserved. Confirmation saves a plan on this device without changing the canvas or sending requests.
localSync.confirmMergeHint: Check the merged preview again. Server versions, permissions and assets must be revalidated before applying or syncing this saved plan.
localSync.mergeInvalid: Complete the required choices and ensure groups, connections, locks and sequence data form a complete valid canvas.
localSync.choiceRequired: This difference needs an explicit choice.
localSync.choiceAutomatic: Only one side changed this item, so that change is preserved. You can also choose the other side.
localSync.proposalSaved: Merge plan saved on this device. It has not been applied or submitted for sync.
localSync.appliedLocal: Reviewed merge applied and saved locally. Server sync is still pending.
localSync.appliedChanged: This merge was applied, but local content has changed since then.
localSync.applyHint: Confirm to replace local content with this reviewed merge. You can Undo it. No server writes occur; downloaded materials require fresh remote authorization and local-original verification. Missing originals are not downloaded automatically.
localSync.settleReadOnly: Refresh server and confirm downloaded baseline
localSync.prepareUpload: Prepare and save server request (do not send)
localSync.uploadPrepared: Original server request saved. Preparation does not send it; inspect the receipt before retrying.
localSync.uploadConsent: Confirm sending this reviewed target to the bound server. Later local edits are not included. The original receipt is checked first; no automatic retry.
localSync.uploadUnsupported: Sync preparation blocked by missing capabilities: {gaps}
localSync.uploadSettled: Original server commit verified and baseline saved. Later local edits remain pending.
localSync.originalReceiptStatus: Original receipt: {status}. Local edits are retained; no new request was sent. Unknown is not success; Fenced forbids resending this request.
localSync.rebaseRequired: Original commit verified, but peer changes require an explicit intent/latest-head review. No canvas was replaced.
localSync.rebaseIntentTitle: 1/2: Later local intent vs actual original commit
localSync.rebaseIntentHint: Baseline is the originally applied local target, not the server commit. Preserve peer objects you had not yet seen. This phase only prepares the next review; it changes no data.
localSync.rebaseLatestTitle: 2/2: Reviewed local intent vs latest remote head
localSync.rebaseLatestHint: Baseline is the verified historical commit. Final confirmation saves this exact plan locally after rechecking the original receipt/head; it does not apply or upload it.
localSync.rebaseSaved: Two-stage rebase plan saved locally. Neither canvas has been replaced; application is still pending.
localSync.rebaseStale: Local content changed since this rebase review. Review again before saving or applying.
localSync.rebaseApplyHint: Recheck the original commit and latest head, then atomically apply this reviewed result locally. Original submission evidence and Undo are retained. No new server transaction is sent.
localSync.rebaseApplied: Rebase saved locally with the verified historical baseline and original evidence. Upload of remaining local changes still requires separate review and consent.
localSync.fenceConsent: Confirm an irreversible server fence for this original transaction. Local content and reviewed intent are retained in an archive. Only this request's adapter draft is stopped. If already committed, it is verified and settled instead; this is not server Undo.
localSync.confirmFence: Confirm fence and retain local archive
localSync.fencedArchived: Original transaction fenced and archived locally. Canvas and baseline were retained; review again before preparing a new request.
localSync.assetUploadHint: Approve each upload step separately. No automatic Node insertion or canvas sync. After reopening, look up the original request and retain its identity.
localSync.uploadMappingSaved: Mapping saved; local Node and Undo retain original IDs. Compare and review a new canonical merge, then separately approve canvas upload. The old proposal cannot be reused.
localSync.uploadLookup: Look up original request / processing status
localSync.assetUploadConsent: Confirm {step}. prepare reserves an asset; ticket signs a lease; renew supersedes it. upload uses network/storage; complete starts verification. publish rechecks Ready, original hash and access before saving the ID mapping; review a new canvas proposal afterwards. No automatic retry or canvas upload.
localSync.uploadMeasurementReviewHint: — means not declared. Server sizes use display orientation. Confirming this mapping preserves the local original and history; it does not publish canvas changes. If the server measurements change, review again.
localSync.uploadPhase: Server asset phase: {phase}. Ready does not mean Node sync was published.
localSync.uploadTicketSaved: Ticket identity saved. Sending bytes requires separate approval.
localSync.uploadBytesSent: Original bytes sent and hash verified. Approve complete separately, then look up processing status.
localSync.uploadHttpFailure: Asset request HTTP {status}; original identity retained. Look up the request; explicitly replace an expired ticket. No automatic retry.
localSync.uploadFailed: Upload incomplete or scope changed. Original request retained. Reload / look up without creating a replacement identity.
localSync.uploadCancelled: Cancelled. Request and ticket retained; no automatic complete, deletion or retransmission.
localSync.uploadMetadataChanged: Server metadata differs from the fixed preparation (dimensions, duration or original identity fields). Original request retained; no Ready mapping granted. The preparation contract needs confirmation; retransmission will not repair this mismatch.
localSync.uploadAuthenticationRequired: Asset service requires authentication (401). Original request retained; check the current account configuration.
localSync.uploadPermissionDenied: This account lacks asset upload / lookup permission (403). This does not mean the asset is missing; no automatic retry.
localSync.uploadLeaseExpired: The original ticket expired. Keep requestId; explicitly approve a replacement ticket if retransmission is needed.
localSync.uploadLeaseSuperseded: This ticket was superseded. Look up the original request and current lease before completing; do not use the old lease.
localSync.uploadOriginalMissing: The server has not found bytes for this lease. Check transfer state; no automatic complete or retransmission.
localSync.uploadRequestNotFound: Original request not found in this scope (404). A late request may still commit. Keep requestId; do not create another asset.
localSync.materializationHint: Inspect metadata, approve saving an identity, then separately approve download. No Node is applied here.
localSync.materializationInspected: Read-only metadata verified. No local original prepared or downloaded.
localSync.materializationSaveWarning: Save this original-to-local identity in the private document. This does not download or apply a Node.
localSync.materializationSaved: Identity saved. Download needs separate approval.
localSync.materializationDownloadWarning: Authorize downloading this workspace original to private local storage (network/storage usage). Existing correct bytes may be reused after fresh authorization and hash verification. No canvas apply or upload. Correct cache may remain after cancellation or late permission changes.
localSync.materializationVerifying: Verifying original bytes and current scope…
localSync.materializationReady: Local original verified. Node references are not applied; canvas application still requires separate review.
localSync.materializationCancelled: Cancelled. Identity retained; no automatic retry or canvas apply.
localSync.materializationFailed: Materialization failed or the review changed. Identity retained. Refresh / review again; no automatic retry. Ready is not granted by this attempt.
localSync.evidenceExportWarning: Exports private canvas content, account/workspace IDs, original request identities and full local archives; no keys. Choose a safe location. This is not fresh server proof or a replayable backup, contains no original media files and does not clear archives.
localSync.confirmEvidenceExport: Confirm private sync evidence JSON export
localSync.settled: Downloaded baseline confirmed. Later local edits remain pending; no server write was sent.
localSync.proposalFailed: Saving is unconfirmed, or local content has changed. Reload to check. The document and any saved plan are preserved.
localSync.proposalReopened: Saved merge plan restored. You can continue reviewing the preview and choices.
localSync.proposalStale: A saved plan exists, but the local or server snapshot has changed. Review choices again before reusing it.
localSync.historicalRemote: This is the historical server snapshot from your saved plan, available for offline review. It is not current permission or a sync acknowledgement. Connect to revalidate before applying.
localSync.title: Sync destination for this local canvas
localSync.hint: Your local document is saved on this device. Connect to select a server space and review its differences and preview. This screen does not submit canvas changes. You can close it and continue offline if the network is unavailable.
localSync.localFailed: Local sync information could not be read. Close and reopen this screen. Your document is preserved.
localSync.failed: Connection or destination saving could not complete. The service may be unavailable, content may have changed, or a server submission needs recovery. Reload the comparison. Your local document is preserved.
localSync.bindWarning: Confirm this is the account and space you want to sync. Saving this destination does not overwrite either side.
localSync.bound: Sync destination saved. Pending local content is preserved.
localSync.initialReview: The initial contents differ. An explicit merge review is required before uploading; neither side can be overwritten automatically.

localStorage.failed: Could not read or save the local document. The file has not been reset.

canvasExport.revealFailed: Could not open the folder. Find the export at the path above.
canvasExport.title: Export PNG / PDF
canvasExport.hint: Export the entire canvas or selected objects.
canvasExport.failed: Export failed. Try again or adjust the export area or scale.
canvasExport.stale: The canvas or session changed. Reopen export.
canvasExport.invalid: Cannot export this selection or size. Select a complete diagram or reduce the scale.
canvasExport.mediaFailed: A media frame is unavailable. Restore its image or video poster before exporting.
canvasExport.mediaHint: GIFs use their first frame; videos use their saved poster. PDF contains a single raster page.
canvasExport.downloadRequested: Download requested. Check your browser downloads to confirm the file was saved.
canvasExport.uncertain: Publication was interrupted. Check the chosen file before retrying.

submissionMigration.cancelled: Stopped. Publication or activation may already have been saved. Original records remain; verify the original receipt before another attempt.
submissionMigration.catalogHint: Optional private JSON: {"version":1,"scopes":[{"apiBase":"exact original /api/v1 URL","userId":"original ID","clientId":"original ID","workspaceId":"original ID"}],"stopped":[{"scope":{"apiBase":"…","userId":"…","clientId":"…","workspaceId":"…"},"transactionId":"original transaction ID"}]}. Use original values, never API keys. This is only locator input; records must match existing hashes and complete contents. Nothing is saved or sent.
submissionMigration.catalogLimit: Input exceeds 4 MiB or contains invalid Unicode; it was not accepted.
submissionMigration.failed: Not confirmed. Original records and request IDs are retained; review source, identity and writer exclusion before trying again.
submissionMigration.inspectPacket: Show / hide full local review packet
submissionMigration.packetWarning: Local review only: this packet includes canvas text, original transaction IDs and recovery evidence. It is not sent to the backend or diagnostic log.
submissionMigration.previewFailed: Cannot confirm the complete source. A missing legacy scope/archive catalog, identity/counter, corrupt data or changed source needs recovery; original data is retained.
submissionMigration.previewOnly: Read-only source review. No data is migrated, no transaction is resent, and no storage mode is changed. Publication and activation are not yet connected on this platform.
submissionMigration.published: Published locally. Activation still requires a separate confirmation.
submissionMigration.title: Review durable draft migration
submissionMigration.warning: Local storage migration only. No pending transaction is resent, no legacy record is removed, and publication alone does not activate the new writer.
